meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条「好设计」原则逐条审查你的设计,每条打 0–3 分并附证据,再判定该新建、改进还是重做,最后给出一个 /make-plan 交接提示和评审文件。
howto.when: 当你提到「audit this design」「design review」「critique this design」等说法,或想要一次能导向计划的评审时触发。

say.text: 用 Rams 十条原则审查这个页面,每条打分并附证据
say.note: 产出评分表和判定文件

say.text: 审一下这个界面,判断该新建、改进还是重做
say.note: 生成对应的 /make-plan 交接提示

say.text: 检查这个 UI 是否够好,并给出下一步计划提示
say.note: 按得分与零分项定判定

howto.what_en: After install, Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten "good design" principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, picks a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict, and hands off a /make-plan prompt plus audit files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", "critique this design" or similar, or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this page against Rams' ten principles, scoring each with evidence
say_en.note: Produces a scorecard and verdict files

say_en.text: Review this UI and tell me whether to build new, refine, or redesign
Check this interface and give me a plan prompt for the next step
say_en.note: Verdict follows the total and zero scores
